scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Hello! Do you need some Q-Pet food?
Or maybe some accessories to decorate your Q-Pet?
There is also a Q-Pet taming item!
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
您好！需要宠物饲料，还是打扮宠物用的饰品？
这里还有宠物驯服道具哦！

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, please buy it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
好的，请随意选购。

[宠物美容师]
好，那就以物易物吧。

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
好的，您随时都可以回来。
